claims.assertion: Mari reports an Alfratan L-class Black Knight crashed in Yukon after evading a missile; both pilots died.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: The account came via Viera high-priority notice.

claims.assertion: She describes the Alcyone Council as the political body representing M45’s Pleiadian races.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says the Council distanced itself from Federation intervention after Alenym presented evidence about Earth.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: She says an accepted treaty would expand Taygeta-Urmah cooperation to all M45 Pleiadian races, despite Federation displeasure.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says Hyadean felines on Merope are genetically identical to Avyon’s Urmah, linking the groups.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
